description: This is a false-colour satellite image showing an example of Calcareous dry grasslands within the Himsklamm Natura 2000 site in Germany, captured on 2012-08-27 by Spot 5 at 2.5 m resolution using a 1/2/3 band combination. The image depicts a landscape characterised by varied vegetation cover, with reddish-brown tones indicating areas of denser or healthier vegetation and lighter brown/greyish-brown tones representing sparser vegetation, rocky outcrops, or dry soil. Several small, dark, circular features resembling ponds or depressions are visible across the terrain. A linear feature, appearing light blue or white within a green outline, traces a watercourse across the upper and left portions of the image. An irregular green line demarcates a boundary, potentially the perimeter of the Natura 2000 site or a specific land cover unit. A small, bright green diamond marker is located in the lower-left quadrant. The image source is CNES 2012©, distributed by Airbus DS/Spot Image.
